title: If a limit of qcqs schemes with affine transition maps is affine, so are the late stages
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system over $I$ of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] whose transition morphisms are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], with limit $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. If $S$ is affine, then there is $i_0\in I$ such that $S_i$ is affine for every $i\ge i_0$ (Stacks Limits, Lemma 01Z6).

source.place: Lemma Tag 01Z6 (lemma-limit-affine, line 680), in Situation 01ZN (situation-descent: directed limit of qcqs schemes with affine transition maps)

mathlib_searches.results: AffineTransitionLimit.lean:1039 @[stacks 01Z6] lemma Scheme.exists_isAffine_of_isLimit [IsCofiltered I] [forall i j f, IsAffineHom (D.map f)] [forall i, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [forall i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)] [IsAffine c.pt] : exists i, IsAffine (D.obj i)

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: the directed set I, viewed as a cofiltered category (I^op), with the limit cone, gives one i_0 with S_{i_0} affine; for i >= i_0 the transition morphism S_i -> S_{i_0} is affine (IsAffineHom), so S_i is affine by AlgebraicGeometry.isAffine_of_isAffineHom (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Affine.lean:185).
